items.title: UK leasehold ban proposal threatens to fragment block buildings insurance market
items.summary: Legislation proposed by the government to replace leaseholds with commonhold will shift buildings insurance procurement responsibilities directly to resident-owned associations.

items.title: GTA VI launch exposes cyber aggregation and vendor dependency risks for UK brokers
items.summary: The launch of Grand Theft Auto VI highlights underlying cyber aggregation risks as shared content delivery networks and payment processors face simultaneous surges in traffic.

items.title: Record mobility scooter casualties highlight insurance gap and council repair backlog
items.summary: Surewise data reveals record mobility scooter casualties in 2025 alongside widespread lack of cover and a growing highway repair backlog.

items.title: Brit Insurance report highlights SME cyber demand amid price sensitivity
items.summary: Brit Insurance finds that while 82% of insured UK SMEs are likely to increase their cyber cover, 55% still choose a provider mainly on price.

items.title: SIAA and EverPeak Insurance announce senior leadership appointments
items.summary: SIAA has appointed Brad Emmons as president, while EverPeak Insurance has named Karin Thompson to lead its national cannabis workers' compensation program.

items.title: Bank of England begins overhaul of Threadneedle Street headquarters amid £160m cost fears
items.summary: The Bank of England has awarded a building contract to modernise its historic headquarters while attempting to avoid the severe cost overruns experienced by the US Federal Reserve.
